messages.subject: Showy milkweed
messages.text:
I can’t figure out your website. I am in California and want showy milkweed. How do i choose it?

Thanks 

Tim

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: Showy milkweed
messages.text:
Hello Tim, 
 

 To make your choice, you can go in the Milkweed Seeds page in our Website : https://lasclay.com/en/collections/garden/products/milkweed-seeds
 

 In the top right corner, you'll find the different species available. Select Speciosa . That is Showy milkweed, Latin name Asclepias speciosa.

 Choose between 1 packet, Pack of 5, or Pack of 10.

 Add it to cart.

 

 For California, Showy milkweed is a reasonable native choice in many parts of the state, especially inland/northern or drier western sites. 
 

 We remain at your disposal if you have any further questions
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay
